   471  /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   472   * Function:    H5F__evict_cache_entries
   473   *
   474   * Purpose:     To evict all cache entries except the pinned superblock entry
   475   *
   476   * Return:      Non-negative on success/Negative on failure
   477   *
   478   * Programmer:  Vailin Choi
   479   *              Dec 2013
   480   *
   481   *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   482   */
   483  herr_t
   484  H5F__evict_cache_entries(H5F_t *f)
   485  {
   486      herr_t ret_value = SUCCEED;
   487
   488      FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE
   489
   490      HDassert(f);
   491      HDassert(f->shared);
   492
   493      /* Evict all except pinned entries in the cache */
   494      if (H5AC_evict(f) < 0)
   495          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_CACHE, H5E_CANTEXPUNGE, FAIL, "unable to evict all except pinned entries")
   496
   497  #ifndef NDEBUG
   498      {
   499          unsigned status = 0;
   500          uint32_t cur_num_entries;
   501
   502          /* Retrieve status of the superblock */
   503          if (H5AC_get_entry_status(f, (haddr_t)0, &status) < 0)
   504              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_HEAP, H5E_CANTGET, FAIL, "unable to get entry status")
   505
   506          /* Verify status of the superblock entry in the cache */
   507          if (!(status & H5AC_ES__IN_CACHE) || !(status & H5AC_ES__IS_PINNED))
   508              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_HEAP, H5E_CANTGET, FAIL, "unable to get entry status")
   509
   510          /* Get the number of cache entries */
   511          if (H5AC_get_cache_size(f->shared->cache, NULL, NULL, NULL, &cur_num_entries) < 0)
   512              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_CACHE, H5E_SYSTEM, FAIL, "H5AC_get_cache_size() failed.")
   513
   514          /* Should be the only one left in the cache (the superblock) */
   515          if (cur_num_entries != 1)
   516              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_CACHE, H5E_SYSTEM, FAIL, "number of cache entries is not correct")
   517      }
   518  #endif /* NDEBUG */
   519
   520  done:
   521      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value);
   522  } /* end H5F__evict_cache_entries() */

   158  static herr_t
   159  H5O__cache_get_initial_load_size(void H5_ATTR_UNUSED *_udata, size_t *image_len)
   160  {
   161      FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE_NOERR
   162
   163      /* Check arguments */
   164      HDassert(image_len);
   165
   166      /* Set the image length size */
   167      *image_len = H5O_SPEC_READ_SIZE;

   172  /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   173   * Function:    H5O__cache_get_final_load_size()
   174   *
   175   * Purpose:     Tell the metadata cache the final size of an object header.
   176   *
   177   * Return:      Success:        SUCCEED
   178   *              Failure:        FAIL
   179   *
   180   * Programmer:  Quincey Koziol
   181   *              November 18, 2016
   182   *
   183   *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   184   */
   185  static herr_t
   186  H5O__cache_get_final_load_size(const void *image, size_t H5_ATTR_NDEBUG_UNUSED image_len, void *_udata,
   187                                 size_t *actual_len)
   188  {
   189      H5O_cache_ud_t *udata     = (H5O_cache_ud_t *)_udata; /* User data for callback */
   190      herr_t          ret_value = SUCCEED;                  /* Return value */
   191
   192      FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE
   193
   194      /* Check arguments */
   195      HDassert(image);
   196      HDassert(udata);
   197      HDassert(actual_len);
   198      HDassert(*actual_len == image_len);
   199
   200      /* Deserialize the object header prefix */
   201      if (H5O__prefix_deserialize((const uint8_t *)image, udata) < 0)
   202          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_OHDR, H5E_CANTDECODE, FAIL, "can't deserialize object header prefix")
   203
   204      /* Sanity check */
   205      HDassert(udata->oh);
   206
   207      /* Set the final size for the cache image */
   208      *actual_len = udata->chunk0_size + (size_t)H5O_SIZEOF_HDR(udata->oh);
   209
   210  done:
   211      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
   212  } /* end H5O__cache_get_final_load_size() */
